coverage.row: Acceptance 1: Published @riftydev/workbench/dep-snapshot produceDepSnapshot writes caller manifest+lock, runs existing install, emits ADR-0386 tar plus snapshotId and installArtifactIdentity; packed consumer imports only that entry and restores matching project bytes.
coverage.note: Executed carrier bakes caller manifest+lock, asserts installArtifactIdentity and sha256 snapshotId, then restores through the sealed entry. Weak only for packed-consumer wording: the tarball lane checks the export map without executing produce/restore from an installed package. Advisory (REV-4); I1 goal residual.

coverage.row: Acceptance 2: A lock that pins older versions keeps those versions when the registry also advertises newer ones; produce does not live-resolve covered pins.
Acceptance 3: Raw gzip and HTTP-decoded tar of the produced archive restore the same bytes through public fetch/restore.
Fault matrix: Corrupt/unsupported input × produce — unparseable lock, lifecycle scripts and native/unsupported specs throw the existing installer errors before a snapshot is emitted.

Fault matrix: Snapshot identity/replay × restore — produced snapshotId mismatch and altered replay closure reject before destination mutation (existing tar/v3 identity carriers plus producer identity case).
Fault matrix: Cancelled registry × produce — caller AbortSignal fails before destination snapshot bytes are returned.
Public API: sealed subpath @riftydev/workbench/dep-snapshot exposing produce/restore/fetch/parse, installArtifactIdentity and createDepSnapshotMemoryFs (ADR-0389).
